title: Replace portfolio headshot with newly uploaded image and refresh cache

requirements.text: Replace the portfolio headshot static assets under "frontend/public/assets/generated" with square-cropped PNGs derived from the newly uploaded image file "Profile picture (2)-4.png", overwriting the existing files using the exact filenames: (1) "portfolio-headshot.dim_512x512.png" (512x512) and (2) "portfolio-headshot-large.dim_1280x1280.png" (1280x1280).

quotes: You was able to remove the actual, now you'll just place this image

acceptanceCriteria: The file "frontend/public/assets/generated/portfolio-headshot.dim_512x512.png" is updated to the new uploaded photo (square crop) and remains 512x512 PNG.
The file "frontend/public/assets/generated/portfolio-headshot-large.dim_1280x1280.png" is updated to the new uploaded photo (square crop) and remains 1280x1280 PNG.
HeroSection displays the updated photo in the circular headshot area using the existing HEADSHOT_512 path.
The HeadshotLightbox displays the updated photo using the existing HEADSHOT_1280 path.

requirements.text: Force a browser cache refresh for the headshot by incrementing the "HEADSHOT_VERSION" value in "frontend/src/content/assetPaths.ts" so that the HEADSHOT_512 and HEADSHOT_1280 URLs change (query-string cache bust), while keeping the headshot filenames unchanged.

quotes: now you'll just place this image

acceptanceCriteria: "frontend/src/content/assetPaths.ts" HEADSHOT_VERSION is increased from its current value so the resulting HEADSHOT_512/HEADSHOT_1280 strings differ from the previous build.
After a hard refresh, the site loads the new headshot without showing the previous/cached image.

requirements.text: Verify that every place the portfolio UI displays the headshot uses the centralized constants from "frontend/src/content/assetPaths.ts" (HEADSHOT_512 and HEADSHOT_1280) rather than any hard-coded headshot image paths, so all headshot renders benefit from cache-busting.

quotes: now you'll just place this image

acceptanceCriteria: No portfolio components reference "/assets/generated/portfolio-headshot" via hard-coded strings; they use HEADSHOT_512 / HEADSHOT_1280 instead.
All headshot renders update automatically when HEADSHOT_VERSION changes.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only UI components).
Do not edit immutable hook files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts / .tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, or frontend/src/main.tsx.
Backend must remain single-actor (all Motoko logic in backend/main.mo); no new backend services.
nonGoals: Adding new portfolio sections or changing resume content.
Introducing a new authentication method beyond Internet Identity.
Adding a new backend image upload pipeline (headshot remains a static frontend asset).

edits: Square-cropped professional headshot portrait updated from uploaded image (portfolio-headshot.dim_512x512.png > portfolio-headshot.dim_512x512.png)
Square-cropped high-resolution professional headshot portrait updated from uploaded image (portfolio-headshot-large.dim_1280x1280.png > portfolio-headshot-large.dim_1280x1280.png)
